name: Buspirone
description: An azapirone 5-HT1A partial agonist approved for generalised anxiety disorder, without the sedation, dependence or withdrawal of benzodiazepines.

systems.note: 5-HT1A partial agonism; the labelled anxiolytic indication.
CYP3A4-metabolised with extensive first pass; dose reduction is labelled in hepatic impairment.
Dose reduction is labelled in renal impairment.

monitors.why: Labelled dose reduction in hepatic impairment.
The accessible instrument for the anxiolytic effect and for emergent mood change.
